basic_information.title: Telemedicine and Remote Patient Vital Monitoring Platform
basic_information.summary: An integrated platform enabling doctors to conduct virtual consultations while monitoring patients' real-time vital signs collected via IoT wearable devices.

abstract: Access to continuous healthcare is a significant challenge for elderly and remote patients. This project introduces a comprehensive telemedicine system integrated with IoT-based remote vital monitoring. Wearable sensors collect continuous data on heart rate, blood oxygen levels (SpO2), and body temperature, transmitting it securely to a cloud database. Healthcare providers can access this data through a web portal, facilitating informed virtual consultations via integrated video conferencing. The system includes an automated alert mechanism that notifies medical staff if a patient's vitals cross predefined critical thresholds, ensuring timely interventions. The solution bridges the gap between clinical visits and continuous patient care.
problem_statement: Continuous monitoring of chronic and post-operative patients is often restricted to hospital environments. Once discharged, lack of real-time health tracking can lead to undetected deteriorations and delayed emergency responses.

primary: Design an IoT gateway to aggregate and transmit vital signs from wearable sensors.
Develop a secure web portal for doctors to review patient history and real-time data.
Integrate a WebRTC-based video consultation module.
secondary: Implement a real-time alerting system for abnormal vital readings.
Ensure data transmission adheres to basic security and privacy standards.

included: IoT sensor data ingestion via MQTT.
Live video calling with text chat.
scope.deployment_context: Cloud-based web application with edge IoT devices for data collection.

features.name: Live Vital Dashboard
features.description: Displays real-time and historical graphs of patient heart rate, SpO2, and temperature.

features.name: Virtual Consultation
features.description: Secure, browser-based video calls between patients and healthcare providers.

features.name: Automated Alerts
features.description: Triggers notifications when vital signs fall outside healthy parameters.

modules.name: IoT Data Ingestion Module
modules.purpose: Receives and validates continuous data streams from hardware sensors.
responsibilities: Listen for MQTT messages from devices.

modules.name: Communication Module
modules.purpose: Manages WebRTC signaling and real-time messaging.
responsibilities: Manage video and audio streams securely.

frameworks.name: Express.js
frameworks.purpose: REST API for user management and historical data retrieval.

frameworks.name: React
frameworks.purpose: User interface for the medical dashboard.

database.name: MongoDB
database.purpose: Store user profiles, consultation notes, and time-series vital data.

apis.name: Twilio Video API
apis.purpose: Provides WebRTC infrastructure for video consultations.

tools.name: MQTT Broker (Mosquitto)
tools.purpose: Handles lightweight messaging for IoT devices.

platforms.name: Web Browser
platforms.purpose: Client access for doctors and patients.

ai_usage.description: System relies on rule-based thresholds for alerts rather than AI prediction.

algorithms.name: Moving Average Filter
algorithms.purpose: Smooth out noisy sensor data before displaying or triggering alerts.

reasons: Requires integration of hardware (IoT) with web software.
Handling real-time data streams and video signaling.

expected_outcomes: A working prototype of the IoT gateway and sensor setup.
A fully functional web platform for patient monitoring and video calls.
Demonstration of real-time alerts based on simulated critical vital signs.
limitations: Accuracy depends on the quality of off-the-shelf sensors used.
Requires stable internet connection for real-time video and data streaming.
future_scope: Implement machine learning for early detection of health deterioration.
Develop native mobile applications for patients.
Expand sensor integrations to include ECG and blood pressure cuffs.
